notes: v0.19.9: Replace repeated VRChat Full logging alerts with a first-time player tracking setup guide for new, unlinked devices. The one-time guide explains VRChat Settings > Debug > Logging > FULL, Quest Documents/Logs folder permission or Android phone Shizuku, and starting the watcher before joining an instance. Users acknowledge once; first-time tracking start reopens the guide if still incomplete. Existing linked installations automatically retain normal operation without an upgrade popup. The guide can always be reopened from Tracking controls > Advanced tools. Daily Tracking, Quest Tools, Quest folder details, and start-status messages no longer repeat the Full logging warning. The app never claims it can read or change VRChat logging settings. All Quest Tools navigation, universal Quest Back, chatbox timing, OSC, existing tracking modes, Node/Relay, avatars, and staff permissions remain unchanged. No Main Launcher or Relay deployments.
